question: Will YES have more holders than NO?
resolution_criteria:
The resolution will be determined after the closing time of this market, which is 14 September 2026 at 00:00 UTC.

If the number of holders with a net YES position is higher than the number of holders with a net NO position, then this market will be resolved YES.

Otherwise it will be resolved NO.

This means that: if there are equally many holders of net YES and net NO positions, then this market will resolve NO.

The correct answer will be determined by looking at the holders section of this page (sorted by position).

If I do not resolve this market within 24 hours after closing, a moderator may do so according to above definitions.
